messages:
maya: heads-up idp hook alert: customers reporting SCIM failures after yesterday's RBAC group rename. Logs show 503 backpressure + KMS decrypt errors.
ben: can you paste the exact error?
maya: from scim-provisioner: "error: KMS.Decrypt failed: InvalidContext" and "queueing request, backoff=4s". also seeing "duplicate externalId" on some groups.
carla: did the RBAC group rename change external_id mapping? that would explain duplicates.
kevin: i rolled the role rename via infra script last night, i didn't update provisioner mappings. oops.
maya: impact? which customers?
maya: two enterprise tenants in EU and one staging customer. users not deprovisioned, but groups flapping in admin UI.
devops-bot: Deploy 1745 completed to scim-provisioner v2.7.3
ben: check KMS: any key alias rotated?
kevin: no alias rotated, but KMS logs show spikes: 429 throttling + several InvalidContext errors around same time as provisioner errors.
maya: hypothesis: the RBAC rename changed the externalId used when constructing encryption context; KMS decrypt fails, provisioner retries, causing duplicate upserts when externalId normalization differs -> duplicate groups + audit noise.
maya: proposed next steps:
- Pause SCIM outbound for affected tenants
- Roll back name-change mapping or add migration script to normalize externalId
- Re-run provisioner with idempotent upsert using stable external id
- Correlate audit logs: search for KMS:InvalidContext and group:create events
carla: I'm on it. Pausing SCIM for tenant EU-42 now.
carla: paused via admin console, command: `/scim pause tenant EU-42` (response: success)
idp-infra: FYI: queued worker backlog grew x6, autoscaler spun up but hit quota
ben: i'll dig into KMS envelope/context code. possibility: we derive context from group.name which changed. need to use immutable id instead.
kevin: confirm we have stable group.uuid in RBAC DB; we should prefer that.
maya: also, audit logs currently show ingestion gaps for ~1m windows — could be due to backpressure. file an incident and page oncall?
maya: filing now.
maya: Incident 2026-03-20-SSO-SCIM-01 created: paging eng-oncall + sec-eng
eng-oncall: acked. reassigning to carla and ben.
carla: quick triage: I see duplicate group records with externalId null and one with "EU-42:marketing" old format.
carla: sample log:
```
time=2026-03-20T02:12:08Z level=error svc=scim-provisioner err="KMS.Decrypt InvalidContext" tenant=EU-42 group=EU-42:marketing
```
ben: found where context built:
```
context := map[string]string{"tenant": tenantID, "group": groupName}
ciphertext, _ := kms.Encrypt(ctx, plaintext, context)
```
ben: fix -> use group.ID not groupName. I'll open PR.
ben: quick mitigation: adding retry jitter and idempotent check on create to avoid duplicate group creation.
maya: security questions: will any keys or secrets be exposed by duplicates? any PII?
carla: no PII exposed. It's group metadata only. But audit logs are noisy; need reconciled events for compliance.
kevin: after patch, we should run a dry-run reconciliation: compute diff between SCIM provisioner state and RBAC authoritative state and produce patch plan.
maya: please include audit id mapping in plan so we can prove no missed deprovisions.
ben: PR 4329 opened: change context -> groupID + add idempotent create
ben: link: https://git.redwood/infra/scim-provisioner/pull/4329
ben: deploying hotfix to canary tenant now.
devops-bot: Canary deploy started: scim-provisioner v2.7.4-hotfix -> tenant staging-01
carla: stg looks clean; KMS decrypt errors gone in logs for staging. backing off pause on EU-42?
maya: wait to unpause until we run reconciliation.
carla: running reconciliation dry-run for EU-42:
- creates: 0
- updates: 3 (normalize externalId)
- deletes: 1 (stale duplicate)
carla: I'll generate signed reconciliation report and upload to S3: s3://rdw-internal/incidents/2026-03-20-SSO-SCIM-01/recon.csv
maya: good. Ben, after your PR merges, please coordinate a migration to normalize external IDs env-wide.
ben: will do. also will add unit tests for KMS context invariants.
sec-eng: note for compliance: make sure the reconciliation report includes KMS request IDs for decrypt calls involved during the incident window.
maya: adding to incident runbook. also capture timeline for postmortem:
- 02:05 change rolled (role rename)
- 02:12 first KMS.InvalidContext error observed
- 02:20 autoscaler pressure -> backlog increased
- 02:32 duplicates started appearing in admin UI
- 02:45 SCIM paused for EU-42
- 03:10 hotfix deployed to staging
- 03:30 reconciliation ran
ben: expected root cause: using mutable human-readable group name to build KMS encryption context and as externalId in SCIM upserts; subsequent rename changed context and broke KMS decrypt -> app retried and created duplicates.
maya: action items:
- [ ] Migrate context to use immutable IDs (ben)
- [ ] Backfill/normalize externalId for all tenants (carla)
- [ ] Add reconciliation run daily for 7 days (kevin)
- [ ] Update incident SLOs and alert thresholds for KMS.InvalidContext spikes (sec-eng)
- [ ] Postmortem document with timeline & compliance artifacts (maya)
carla: uploading reconciliation report now. s3 link posted.
carla: unpausing SCIM for EU-42 after manual vetting.
devops-bot: SCIM outbound resumed for tenant EU-42
maya: monitor audit logs for 1h and then close incident if stable.
ben: monitoring. KMS errors zeroed. group flapping stopped.
maya: thumbs. closing incident in 1h if no regressions.
eng-oncall: closing loop: will include remediation tickets in sprint.
ben: PR merged and scheduled for full deploy in 4 hours.
maya: thanks all :tada:
